title: geckolib issue #887: TextureManagerMixin fails to apply on Forge 1.20.1-47.4.10 (m_118506_ not found) - reproducible on vanilla MDK

text:
[issue by ru95-afk]
**GeckoLib version:** 4.8.3 (also reproduced on 4.7.3)
**Forge version:** 1.20.1-47.4.10 (also reproduced on 47.2.20)
**Mapping:** official, 1.20.1
**Java:** tried both Eclipse Adoptium 17.0.18 and 17.0.20 - same result

### Description
The game crashes on startup (`runClient`) with a Mixin apply failure for
`client.TextureManagerMixin`. The injection target method `m_118506_`
(TextureManager, ResourceLocation -> AbstractTexture) cannot be found.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Download a fresh vanilla Forge MDK for 1.20.1-47.4.10 (no other mods).
2. Add GeckoLib as a dependency in build.gradle:
```groovy
   repositories {
       maven {
           name = 'GeckoLib'
           url 'https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/geckolib3/geckolib/maven/'
       }
   }
   dependencies {
       implementation fg.deobf("software.bernie.geckolib:geckolib-forge-1.20.1:4.8.3")
   }
```
3. Add the geckolib dependency block to mods.toml.
4. Run `./gradlew runClient`.

This reproduces on a completely untouched MDK with GeckoLib as the ONLY
added dependency (i.e. not specific to any custom mod code).

### Crash log excerpt
[Render thread/FATAL] [mixin/]: Mixin apply failed geckolib.mixins.json:client.TextureManagerMixin -> net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.TextureManager: org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.throwables.InvalidInjectionException Critical injection failure: @Inject annotation on wrapAnimatableTexture could not find any targets matching 'Lnet/minecraft/client/renderer/texture/TextureManager;m_118506_(Lnet/minecraft/resources/ResourceLocation;)Lnet/minecraft/client/renderer/texture/AbstractTexture;' in net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.TextureManager. Using refmap geckolib.refmap.json

### What I've already tried
- Clean rebuild (deleted `.gradle`, `run`, and ForgeGradle global caches)
- Tried GeckoLib 4.8.3 and 4.7.3 (both fail identically) — updated `mods.toml` versionRange accordingly for 4.7.3
- Tried two different JDK 17 builds (Adoptium 17.0.18 / 17.0.20)
- Disabled/excluded antivirus scanning on the project and gradle cache folders, then fully disabled the antivirus (including AMSI protection) and deleted/re-downloaded the GeckoLib deobf cache — same exact crash still occurs
- Confirmed the issue also occurs on a brand-new, completely vanilla MDK with GeckoLib as the only dependency (rules out any custom mod code as the cause)
- Tried an older Forge patch, **47.2.20**, on the same vanilla MDK + GeckoLib 4.8.3 setup — same exact crash occurs, ruling out a specific Forge patch version as the cause
- Tried pinning the ForgeGradle plugin version explicitly (the range `[6.0,6.2)` was resolving to `6.0.54`) down to `6.0.24` — same exact crash still occurs

### Important note: works fine as a player
On this same PC, GeckoLib 4.8.4 (released jar, installed via a normal launcher/modpack)
works completely normally when actually playing Forge 1.20.1 — no crash, mods load fine.
